data.one_liner: Detects whether the device location is being simulated or faked.
data.what_it_does: The plugin checks if the current location comes from software simulation or an external accessory. It provides an optional iOS‑only flag to ignore accessory‑based locations.
use_when: You need to guard location‑based features against spoofed data
Compliance or security requirements demand detection of mock locations
avoid_when: You only need raw location data without spoof detection
Targeting platforms earlier than iOS 15 where detection isn’t possible
strengths: Simple API with a single async call
Supports both software‑simulated and accessory‑based detection
Configurable iOS option to reduce false positives
weaknesses: No Android‑specific detection beyond permission handling
Limited to detection only, no mitigation
data.setup_notes: Add detect_fake_location to pubspec, request location permissions (permission_handler), and include iOS/Android location permissions in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml.
